# Context caching

## Implicit caching  {% id="implicit-caching" %}

Implicit caching is enabled by default for all Gemini 2.5 and newer models.

| Model | Min token limit |
| :--- | :--- |
| Gemini 4 Carbon | 4,096 |
| Gemini 3.8 Flash | 4,096 |

## Explicit caching  {% id="explicit-caching" %}

Explicit context caching is currently in Beta. Endpoints and SDK methods are
available under `v1beta`. Explicit caching is not supported for Gemini 4 models.

### Generate content using a cache  {% id="generate-content" %}

  {% tab label="REST" %}
  ```shell
  echo '{"model": "models/gemini-3.8-flash"}' > request.json
  curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/cachedContents?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY" -d @request.json > cache.json
  curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.8-flash:generateContent?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY" -d '{"cachedContent":"some-cache"}'
  ```
  {% /tab %}
